title: SCAP-NG Test Result draft v0.3.0 strawman
description: Detailed technical result for one authored Test. Test-local predicate positions, not independently named State artifacts, determine comparison identities.

state_refs.description: Ordered identifiers of consumer-local Test predicates. Canonical 0.3 form is <test-id>.states[<zero-based-index>], including repeated identical predicates at separate positions. No separately named authored States are required.

item_refs.description: Only the collected Item IDs retained under per_item_results or otherwise needed to explain the Test. This list is not an unbounded enumeration of every evaluated Item; the required item_summary provides evaluated, failing and retained counts when reporting is capped.

state_results.description: Each local comparison result identifies one lexical Test.states array position; it must resolve against this Test's ordered state_refs, not a source OVAL State ID.

item.description: Reported system Item with typed attributes, embedded beside this Test's verdict and State comparisons. The item.id SHALL equal item_ref. This is the Test-local evidence, not a second independently evaluated observation.

per_item_results.description: Test-local reported system Items and their evaluated State/Entity comparisons, subject to scanner-controlled evidence retention. This array can be a sample; never infer counts or collection completeness from its length.

item_summary.description: Required counts for every technical Test, including no-item, unknown and capped-evidence cases. Evaluated Items and mismatches describe execution; returned_items counts retained per_item_results; actual_mismatches is unknown if full relevant population was not evaluated. Consistency between these values, the assessment retention cap and retained Items SHALL be validated beyond JSON Schema.
